context: 各专业分别有多少名学生？
question: 只看2024届毕业生的
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM student s JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id WHERE s.graduation_year = 2024 GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY student_count DESC
note: 追加过滤条件：省略了主语和聚合，必须从上下文补回来

context: 各城市的岗位数量分别是多少？
question: 排除实习岗位
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS posting_count FROM job_posting WHERE job_type <> '实习' GROUP BY city ORDER BY posting_count DESC
note: 在原分组统计上加一个过滤条件

context: 各行业的平均起薪是多少？只看已签约的offer
question: 只看互联网行业
gold_sql: SELECT c.industry, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM offer o JOIN company c ON o.company_id = c.id WHERE o.sign_status = '已签约' AND c.industry = '互联网' GROUP BY c.industry
note: 从分组统计收窄到单个取值。注意：收窄条件不应该改变输出结构——上一轮返回「行业+平均薪资」，这一轮过滤到一个行业后仍应返回这两列

context: 各学院分别有多少名学生？
question: 哪个学院最多？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count FROM college c JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 1
note: 从「全部列出」变成「取 Top1」

question: 其中签约的有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS signed_count FROM offer WHERE sign_status = '已签约'
note: 「其中」是典型的指代，必须知道上文问的是 offer

context: 各专业的平均绩点是多少？
question: 只保留平均绩点高于3.2的专业
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, ROUND(AVG(s.gpa), 2) AS avg_gpa FROM major m JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name HAVING AVG(s.gpa) > 3.2 ORDER BY avg_gpa DESC
note: 对聚合结果加 HAVING 条件

question: 只看毕业生超过15人的专业
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, ROUND(100.0 * es.employed_count / es.graduated_count, 2) AS employment_rate FROM employment_stat es JOIN major m ON es.major_id = m.id WHERE es.stat_month = '2024-06' AND es.major_id IS NOT NULL AND es.graduated_count > 15 ORDER BY employment_rate DESC
note: 在已有 WHERE 基础上追加阈值条件

context: 各投递渠道的录用率分别是多少？
question: 哪个渠道最低？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已录用' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hire_rate FROM job_application GROUP BY channel ORDER BY hire_rate ASC LIMIT 1
note: 从「全部列出」变成「取最小」，排序方向要反过来
